cards.title: What colour is octopus's blood? The kids' quiz
cards.body: Five multiple-choice questions set by children test your knowledge on fun facts. Submit your own junior brainteasers for future quizzes.

cards.title: I've got feelings for a teacher at school. What should I do?
cards.body: Crushes can feel freeing because they operate outside everyday life. But acting on them when you're married with children requires careful consideration.

cards.title: What to Consider Before Homeschooling Your Child
cards.body: Homeschooling requires careful planning and consideration of important factors. Parents should weigh the benefits and challenges before making this educational choice.

cards.title: Teaching Children How to Use AI Safely
cards.body: Parents need to help children navigate artificial intelligence technology effectively. Six family rules can guide parents in establishing healthy AI usage habits.

cards.title: College Students May Face Greater AI Risks Than Children
cards.body: Developmental safeguards are often removed at 18, but the prefrontal cortex remains under construction until the mid-20s. The timing of AI exposure during this critical period is especially concerning.
